The opportunity

Farms now raise half the world's seafood. Feed is their biggest bill.

51%of the world's seafood came from aquaculture in 2022
$110B+spent every year on processed, external feed
60%of a typical farm's production cost is feed
500,000+aquafarms worldwide, still dependent on bought feed

Aquaculture share: FAO, The State of World Fisheries and Aquaculture 2024.

The problem

The market grows. Farm margins don't.

60%

of operating cost goes to feed

Feed costs more than labor, water and equipment combined. Lower it and the whole profit and loss statement moves with it.

Total

dependent on outside suppliers

Feed quality drives the feed conversion ratio, fish health and water quality at once. A farm that buys all its feed has handed control of all three to someone else.

  • Supplier bottleneckscap how fast a farm can scale
  • Processed feedraises nitrite and degrades farm water
  • Margins stay flatwhile seafood demand heads toward $650B
The solution

An autonomous feed plant, installed on the farm.

Yamim converts local, natural resources into live feed and balances it continuously against the farm's existing pellet supply. Farms keep their pellets and buy fewer of them.

Produce

On-site AI production

Turns local biomass into protein-rich live feed right where the fish are.

Balance

Balanced nutrition

Blends live feed with existing pellets so the fish get consistent nutrition every day.

Learn

Adaptive optimization

Monitors water and stock in real time and keeps improving efficiency, welfare and water quality.

In the field

Already running in real tanks.

Yamim is five years into the build: validated with Israeli fish growers, backed by the Israel Innovation Authority, and now running R&D on a working pilot.
